objects.description: [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has gathered information about files on the victim machine.(Citation: Unit42_Vidar_July2026) Specifically, [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has used `FindFirstFileExW` and `FindNextFileW`.(Citation: Cyfirma_Vidar_June2024)(Citation: Logpoint_StealerMalwareFamilies_2024) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has attempted to read hidden system directories, such as `$Recycle.Bin`, `$Windows.~BT`, and `$SysReset`, and the `C:\Windows\System32\config\SOFTWARE` directory using the `ReadFile` function. [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has also accessed internal streams, such as `$SDH`, and has read Jump Lists, which include recently opened files, programs and tasks.(Citation: Cyfirma_Vidar_June2024)
